verdict.rationale: Exa's Websets feature lets a user give a natural-language task ('find agtech companies that raised Series A') and the product autonomously searches, verifies, and enriches results, including via a no-code Dashboard — a form of built-in delegated agent inside the product (exa-docs-7, exa-docs-8, exa-docs-15). However hands-on community reports show this delegation is unreliable in practice (missed data fields, results stuck 'Verifying...', slower than expected) (exa-comm-2, exa-comm-3, exa-comm-4), and most of Exa's other 'agent' framing (Exa Agent, MCP) is really about wiring Exa into external AI assistants rather than an assistant native to the product itself. Missing for 10: a dedicated conversational/task-delegation assistant UI beyond Websets, and independent verification that Websets reliably completes delegated tasks end-to-end.
